data.DebugDisplay: [West Ham will certainly look back at some great wins along the way with perhaps the most notable including a 2-1 triumph against Liverpool, an emphatic 3-0 win against Man UFC, a comprehensive 3-0 triumph versus Crystal Palace and a 2-0 triumph against Norwich. The Hammers' path to league success was helped by four goals from Lucas Paquetá. With the club having offered a reported maximum bonus pot of £2.2M for winning the competition at the start of the season, West Ham players have certainly got a lot to celebrate.]

data.DebugDisplay: [It was a season to remember for Aston Villa as, thanks to results like their 2-1 victory over Chelsea, they managed to finish 5th, four spots above their pre-season expectations of a 9th place finish. Aston Villa's impressive rise through the middle of the season helped to build a solid platform for a successful campaign, with the club now 5th in the table.]

data.name: text
data.DebugDisplay: [It was a season to forget for Manchester United, who performed poorly in finishing 10th, six spots below their pre-season expectations of 4th, due in part to results like their 1-3 defeat against Arsenal. Antony was singled out as a particular disappointment over the course of the campaign. Man UFC suffered a huge drop in the middle of the season, falling from 2nd to 10th, and now have work to do just to rescue some respectability from their campaign.]
